text:
On the sandy banks of the Mandakini, she delighted herself with balls and dolls. In her childhood, she often remained in the midst of her friends, as if immersed in the joy of play.

Like the Ganges in autumn, like a great healing herb, or like the self-radiance of the night, rows of swans approached her. Those possessing knowledge from previous births came to her at the time of instruction, finding her steady in her teachings.
